title: What Spintronic Memory Devices Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Spintronic memory devices store bits in electron spin rather than charge: magnetic tunnel junctions flip between parallel and antiparallel states to represent 0 and 1. The result is memory that is fast like SRAM, dense like DRAM, and nonvolatile like flash — with near-zero standby power. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Spintronic Memory Devices: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Spintronic Memory Devices in one line: Spintronic memory devices store bits in electron spin rather than charge: magnetic tunnel junctions flip between parallel and antiparallel states to represent 0 and 1.
Why it matters: It could unify the memory hierarchy: one technology replacing SRAM, DRAM, and flash in many roles..
Where it is used: embedded memory, last-level cache, automotive MCUs, AI accelerators, instant-on devices..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of Spintronic Memory Devices
title: Current Research State of Spintronic Memory Devices
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: STT-MRAM entered commercial production as embedded memory; SOT-MRAM promises faster, lower-energy switching; and voltage-controlled (VCMA) variants target ultra-low power. Research focuses on switching current reduction, retention at small nodes, and 3D stacking. The gap: density and cost vs DRAM/flash at scale. Research moves in three waves: laboratory proof of concept, scaled prototypes under controlled conditions, and field trials. Spintronic Memory Devices currently sits at the stage described above, and the pieces records show what each wave still needs.
